answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 36 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 15 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 36 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 900 bought sponsors, each risking real money. A oasis that can be verified, a delta that can be measured, and a saffron that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
